instruction.thesis: The FUNDING_EXTREME_SHORT thesis for GOLD long was triggered when HL funding was -44.78% annualized. Funding has now fully normalized to +5.48% annualized — a +50pp swing — which is the primary thesis completion signal. Gold spot is essentially flat from entry (4,536 → 4,534, -0.04%), so the carry benefit has been the main return driver. With funding now positive, the thesis is complete: the crowded shorts have covered and funding has normalized. Holding further exposes us to paying positive funding with no directional edge. Close at near-breakeven to free capital.

instruction.thesis: The FUNDING_EXTREME_SHORT thesis for AMZN long was triggered when HL funding was -29.81% annualized. Funding has now normalized to +5.48% annualized — a +35pp swing — which is the primary thesis completion signal. The perp has converged toward spot (basis improved from -0.36% to -0.16%), and the stock is flat. The thesis is complete: crowded shorts have covered and funding normalized. With funding now positive, we are paying carry with no remaining edge. The AMZN P/C ratio has risen from 0.489 to 0.532, indicating some put buying which is a mild headwind. Close at small profit to free capital.
